2607.02201.title: The Eticas AI Risk Taxonomy: Open Infrastructure for Operationalizing AI Audits
2607.02201.paper_summary: The rapid deployment of AI systems across high-stakes domains has created urgent demand for standardized evaluation, yet the field remains fragmented across competing risk taxonomies that catalog risks without showing how an audit is executed. At least 74 AI risk taxonomies exist, and almost all stop at the catalog. The hard part of auditing is not naming a risk but operationalizing it: turning it into a test run against a real system, a measured value, a calibrated severity, and a defensible grade. This paper leads with that bridge. We present the operationalization layer Eticas has built and run, shown end to end on a single risk (PII leakage) against a public benchmark, and then the open taxonomy that makes the method scale. On GPT-4-0314, a disclosure risk that seven external frameworks require be controlled is measured at 0%, 51%, and 84% disclosure as adversarial conditioning increases, mapping through calibrated severity bands to a subcategory grade of E with a SYSTEMIC pattern. Around this example, the Eticas AI Risk Taxonomy v2.0.0 organizes 76 active subcategories across 10 categories and 20 sub-groups, with mappings to 18 external frameworks across compliance, reference, and academic tiers. Its category and sub-group layer is published under CC BY 4.0 as open semantic infrastructure with stable URIs and SKOS/JSON-LD distributions, and a worked subcategory example shows the operational layer down to its severity thresholds. The contribution is the demonstrated bridge from concept to graded finding, anchored by a clean separation of risks from the mechanisms by which they surface, and framed by an open-core model in which the conceptual scaffold is open and the methodology calibration is the practitioner layer. This is the infrastructure the AI auditing field needs: shared, open, and demonstrably operable.
2607.02201.paper_summary_zh: 高風險領域中AI系統的快速部署創造了對標準化評估的迫切需求，然而該領域仍然因競爭性的風險分類法而顯得支離破碎，這些分類法列出了風險卻未顯示審計是如何執行的。至少存在74種AI風險分類法，幾乎所有的分類法都止步於目錄。審計的難點不在於命名風險，而在於將其操作化：將其轉化為對實際系統的測試運行、一個可測量的值、一個經過校準的嚴重性和一個可辯護的等級。本文以這座橋樑為主題。我們展示了Eticas所構建和運行的操作化層，並在一個公共基準上針對單一風險（PII洩漏）展示了端到端的過程，然後是使該方法可擴展的開放分類法。在GPT-4-0314上，七個外部框架要求控制的披露風險在對抗性條件增加時測量為0%、51%和84%的披露，通過經過校準的嚴重性帶映射到E級的子類別等級，並呈現出系統性模式。在這個例子周圍，Eticas AI風險分類法v2.0.0在10個類別和20個子組中組織了76個活躍的子類別，並與合規、參考和學術層級的18個外部框架進行了映射。其類別和子組層級以CC BY 4.0的開放語義基礎設施發布，擁有穩定的URI和SKOS/JSON-LD分發，並且一個具體的子類別示例展示了操作層及其嚴重性閾值。這一貢獻是從概念到分級發現的橋樑，通過將風險與其浮現機制清晰分離而固定，並以開放核心模型框架，其中概念支架是開放的而方法論的校準是從業者層級。這是AI審計領域所需的基礎設施：共享、開放且可明顯操作。
